# Keybindings

The `--tui` screens' keybindings (ADR-002). A binding with no flag moves the cursor, switches screen, or leaves the TUI, and changes no field of the request being built.

| Key | Action | Flag |
|---|---|---|
| `u` | opt out of masking this column, with a reason | `--unmask` |
| `S` | refuse a column the config has never seen | `--strict-schema` |
| `R` | make this table the root | `--root` |
| `n` | root rows | `--take` |
| `c` | children per parent key on this table | `--cap` |
| `d` | child depth | `--depth` |
| `x` | drop this table to schema only | `--skip-table` |
| `↑/k` | up a row | (navigation) |
| `↓/j` | down a row | (navigation) |
| `b/pgup` | up a page | (navigation) |
| `f/pgdn` | down a page | (navigation) |
| `g` | first row | (navigation) |
| `G` | last row | (navigation) |
| `tab` | the other screen | (navigation) |
| `?` | every key and the flag it is | (navigation) |
| `enter` | leave and run | (navigation) |
| `esc` | leave, or discard this answer | (navigation) |
| `q` | leave without running | (navigation) |
